q: The best type of soil for growing most agricultural crops is ____ soil. (P3)
explain: Loam contains a balanced mixture of sand, clay, silt, and rich organic humus.

q: Which type of soil has the smallest particles and holds water the longest? (P3)
explain: Clay particles are very fine and pack tightly, retaining heavy water.
hint: Sticky when wet, used for pottery.

q: In the life cycle of a butterfly, the caterpillar stage is also called the ____. (P3)
explain: The active feeding stage between egg and pupa is the larva (caterpillar).
hint: Feeding stage before becoming a pupa.

q: A tadpole breathes underwater using ____ before growing lungs. (P3)
explain: Young tadpoles have external/internal gills to extract dissolved oxygen from water.
hint: Breathing organ used by aquatic animals.

q: Foods rich in PROTEIN are mainly needed in the body for ____. (P3)
explain: Proteins (meat, eggs, beans, fish) supply amino acids for muscle growth and healing.

q: Carbohydrates (rice, yam, bread) mainly provide our bodies with ____. (P3)
explain: Carbohydrates are the body's primary fuel source.
hint: Provides physical power to work and play.

q: A dark shape formed when an opaque object blocks light is called a ____. (P3)
explain: Light travels in straight lines; when blocked by an opaque object, a shadow is cast behind.
hint: Formed behind you on a sunny day.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): What is the chemical formula of pure water?
explain: H₂O is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Which organ pumps blood in the human body?
explain: Heart is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Which gas do humans inhale for cellular respiration?
explain: Oxygen is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Which gas do green plants absorb during photosynthesis?
explain: Carbon dioxide is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): What is the freezing point of pure water at sea level?
explain: 0°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): What is the boiling point of pure water at standard atmospheric pressure?
explain: 100°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The female reproductive cell in humans and animals is the ____.
explain: ovum (egg) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The male reproductive cell in animals is the ____.
explain: sperm is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Animals that eat ONLY plants are called ____.
explain: herbivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Animals that eat ONLY meat and other animals are called ____.
explain: carnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Animals that eat BOTH plants and meat are called ____.
explain: omnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The largest organ of the human body is the ____.
explain: skin is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The framework of bones that supports and protects human organs is the ____.
explain: skeleton is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Sound cannot travel through a ____ because there are no particles to vibrate.
explain: vacuum (empty space) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Which energy is obtained directly from the sun?
explain: Solar energy is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
explain: Jupiter is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): Which planet is famous for its bright, prominent rings?
explain: Saturn is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The process by which seeds begin to sprout and grow into young seedlings is ____.
explain: germination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower is ____.
explain: pollination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The loss of water vapour from the leaves of plants through stomata is ____.
explain: transpiration is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The powerhouse organelle inside animal and plant cells that produces energy is the ____.
explain: mitochondrion is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The control center of a biological cell containing genetic DNA is the ____.
explain: nucleus is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The rigid outer protective layer found in plant cells but absent in animal cells is the ____.
explain: cell wall is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The force of attraction between any two masses in the universe is ____.
explain: gravitation is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P3): The measure of how much matter is packed into a given volume is called ____.
explain: density is the scientifically verified fact.
